Built with Processing and the SoundCipher library.

Prime numbers have no divisors except 1 and themselves. All possible divisors are checked for each number, if any are found they are shown in the pattern to the left of the screen and in the number line across the top.

Musical notes are played based on any divisors of each number, the pitch of the note is based on the number.

As prime number have no divisors they are shown against silence.

A 4 colour CMYK (cyan, magenta, yellow & black) plot using coarse spiral-filled dots for cyan, magenta and yellow with a higher-resolution black made from a spiral. The pens are Tombow water-based markers and a Pilot V-Ball Grip 0.5

videos.t: Plotter Pen Lift Servos: open power supply PCB for brushless servos
videos.desc:
My previous pen lift video is here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qwu3u70EML4

For a while I've been running on a high-voltage brushless servo which can't be supplied with power by the EiBotBoard directly because:
 - It only outputs 5V and the brushless servo really wants 7V+
 - It can only safely output perhaps 200mA at 5V and the brushless servo can easily take 2000mA which would probably make the EiBotBoard very unhappy

As a result I made a terrible power supply board from perfboard and a cheap DC-DC converter but I wasn't happy to share it because it's easy to get things wrong and this
